summary: Asus TUF A15 (2022) laptop, model number: TUF-A15-HE025T
detected_fault: Battery draining issue when fully charged and completely powered off
suggested_solution: Calibrate the battery by letting it drain to 0% and then charging it to 100%
Check for any BIOS updates and install the latest version
Verify that the ErP feature is enabled in the BIOS setup
Consider replacing the RAM with new kits 16×2 32GB
